name: Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra
briefDescription: The scheme empowers tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project cost.
descriptionMd: The "Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Under this scheme, tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project costs and the remaining 50% as a loan at a concessional interest rate.
benefitsMd: > **Monetary Benefit** - 50% of the project cost or ₹5,00,000, whichever is less, provided as subsidy. - The remaining 50% of the project cost is provided as a loan. > ***Subsidy Disbursement*** - Given in two installments – 60% in the first installment and 40% in the second installment. > ***Interest Rate*** - Loan at 4% per annum. > ***Repayment*** - Loan (excluding subsidy) must be repaid in 20 equal installments over 5 years, including interest. - Option to repay earlier is allowed. > ***Beneficiary Contribution*** - No upfront contribution required from the beneficiary.
eligibilityMd: - The applicant must be a woman. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be residing in a tribal area. - The applicant must be engaged in or willing to establish a self-employment venture through a Nahri Kendra.
applicationMd: ##### ***Registration Process*** - Visit the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation [official website](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/home). - Click on the "[APPLY FOR LOAN](https://adijatinigam.gujarat.gov.in/gtdcloan)".- Select the scheme name "Foreign Study". - Fill the registration form: Full Name (as per Aadhaar Card), Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Uder name, Password for login, Confirm Password. - Click on the "Sign Up. - After successful registration, User ID and Password will be generated. ##### ***Application Process*** - Enter User ID, Password, and Captcha Code. - After login, schemes applicable to your caste will be displayed. - Click on the scheme you want to apply for. - Fill the "Application Form" and upload the required documents - Click Save Application. The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.
